video_prompt: One continuous full-frame shot of a dark cozy podcast studio at night: the video fills the whole frame edge to edge from the first frame to the last. The woman — an Indian woman about 29 years old with medium brown skin and long straight black hair — sits alone in her armchair and stays exactly the same person the whole time: same face, same hair, same clothes, same headphones, same seat, same distance from the camera. Locked-off camera on a tripod; the room around her stays still and empty, only the candle flames flicker. She talks to the person off-camera, confident and knowing, relaxed, small natural head and hand movements.
